facts: Exact WAT command uses 250 cycles and `-s BMC_P DC OS OS_I BMC_I`.
source_snapshot.v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE and assumes named OS-ping scenario.

original_test_intent.statement: Run 250 WAT DC reboot cycles and verify OS ping/reachability plus overall system health after each cycle.
must_preserve: 250 cycles, DC reboot and OS ping polling.
unknowns: Private WAT flag mapping, DC method, ping target/cadence/timeout and scenario order.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It does not explicitly require owner proof that the shown generic scenario flags enable the title's OS Ping check.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Do not infer private WAT semantics; obtain package-specific mapping of `OS_I`/sequence to OS Ping before 250 DC cycles.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run 250 WAT DC Reboots with OS Ping Validation
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify OS network reachability and system recovery after each of 250 approved DC reboot cycles.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Pinned WAT package on a dedicated SUT with approved BMC/host credential channels.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One SUT, exactly 250 cycles, declared OS ping endpoint/interface and DC reboot mechanism.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: WAT hash/version/dependencies, signed flag-to-OS-Ping mapping, BMC endpoint/secret path, DC semantics, explicit boot-ready signal and timeout, ping source/interface/target/count/interval/allowed-loss and timeout rule, immutable inventory/error baseline, signed failure/retry/resume count policy, interpretation of 1800 minutes, and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Validate command dry-run/help, then run the exact scenario through protected secrets. For each numbered attempt, record the DC action, wait for the explicit boot-ready signal, execute the exact ping rule, compare the complete required inventory/health to baseline before continuing, and abort on policy failure. Retries are diagnostic only and never affect completion; a failed campaign cannot resume toward PASS, and only a separately authorized and labeled new campaign can produce a new result.
revision_candidate.preconditions: OOB/recovery, per-cycle comparison and evidence capacity are ready. The owner has declared whether 1800 minutes is planning metadata, a timeout or an acceptance duration; it cannot be inferred by the agent.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Package provenance; signed OS-Ping and 1800-minute semantics; redacted invocation; immutable attempt ledger; per-attempt DC/boot-ready/ping parameters, results and timing; per-attempt full inventory/health/log diff before continuation; explicit failure/retry/resume disposition; BMC/SEL/host deltas and final state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Exactly 250 numbered DC cycles meet the explicit boot-ready and ping rules with complete per-cycle inventory/health, and no cycle fails. Any failure in the campaign prevents PASS; a retry may be diagnostic only, and only a separately authorized wholly new campaign can establish a new result. No extra success can replace or erase a failed cycle.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No credentials on command line/logs, guessed flags, hidden retry, log clearing or warm/AC substitution.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner approves WAT recipe and disruptive window.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent can run verified harness; engineer judges anomalies.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Abort and fail the current campaign, preserve the failed attempt, recover via OOB, and permit only a separately labeled diagnostic retry or separately authorized new campaign; never resume the failed campaign as PASS, renumber or replace the failure.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unmapped scenario; unresolved boot/ping/count/1800-minute semantics; ping or boot failure; per-cycle device/health mismatch; exposed secret; error/hang; or evidence/OOB failure.

reason_for_change: Identical WAT syntax appears under different polling titles, so V3 demands package-specific proof that this invocation actually performs OS Ping.
removed_ambiguities: OS Ping endpoint and cadence are explicit inputs.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 detects that the displayed command alone does not prove the named poll function and prevents 250 destructive cycles from validating only generic reboot health.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Initial validator found underspecified boot/ping success, per-cycle inventory, retry counting and 1800-minute semantics. After iterative correction, revalidation confirmed any failure ends the campaign, retries are diagnostic only and only a new authorized campaign can establish a new result.
